## Give him the goal, not the ticket. [...] Why it works

### Context is what unlocks autonomy.

How much you can hand to an agent depends on how much he understands. A coding tool sees the repository, so it can be given a task. Viktor sees your customers, your metrics and the decisions behind the work, so he can be given the outcome. That is the frontier we are moving: every piece of context raises the level of autonomy.

### One agent, not two.

The usual arrangement is two agents: one that knows the company and one that writes the code. Neither knows what the other knows. Viktor is the AI employee who already knows your company. Now he has the repository too. So a customer's complaint can become a pull request without anyone explaining it twice.
